It still contains graphical/UI code and the preserved incomplete Unity Buddy AR source scaffold pending destination acceptance.

Bernds-tech/WellFit-Buddy.note: Buddy authority with merged WF-MIG-002 source baseline and Git LFS preparation, but no complete Unity runtime, successful build or real-device acceptance. General technical mobile/application ownership remains in WellFit-now.

repo_memory_alignment.evidence: Roles and the exact WF-MIG-002 source baseline are aligned; physical graphical ownership and Buddy runtime migration remain incomplete.

cross_repo_contracts.evidence: Technical authority is substantially implemented; Buddy contract boundaries are baselined, while event schemas, graphical consumer handoff and end-to-end acceptance remain incomplete.

integration_e2e.evidence: No exact-version graphical + technical + Buddy end-to-end mission/Buddy journey is accepted.

convergence_readiness.evidence: WF-MIG-002 is approved for bounded fresh-destination initialization; source retention, destination compile/build/device proof and graphical migration remain open.

real_program_truth: WellFit-now is the technical product authority and currently the physical primary codebase.
WellFit-Buddy is the Buddy authority, not the owner of all general technical mobile application logic.
Closed-Beta auth/session hardening, server-authoritative missions/economy, Buddy backend and global-location foundations exist in WellFit-now.

At WellFit-now commit 447093decd783b33a6e724170dbe4667e899348b, native/unity/WellFitBuddyAR is useful scaffold/reference material but not a complete or compile-ready Unity project; WellFit-Buddy main contains the reviewed baseline only and has no accepted build/device runtime.
WF-MIG-002 is approved as MIGRATE_NOW through a fresh version-pinned destination and incremental reviewed ports while preserving the source until acceptance.
The three repositories may later converge further; no single final target repository or target date has been chosen.

The owner-approved mobile target is a single persistent full-screen camera/AR world with minimal logo/menu chrome and overlay feature panels; it is specified by WF-CONTRACT-MOBILE-SHELL-001 but not yet implemented or device-accepted.
rules: This file is the only WellFit program-level memory authority while the three repositories remain separate.
Local repositories own their domain truth; this master owns only cross-repository coordination truth.
WellFit = graphics/UI/UX; WellFit-now = technical product; WellFit-Buddy = Buddy domain.
A local accepted state does not imply cross-repository integration acceptance.
No final convergence target repository or date may be inferred before an explicit reviewed decision.
Always distinguish intended repository ownership from current physical code location.
General technical mobile/application logic follows WellFit-now unless it is specifically Buddy behavior, Buddy presentation/animation or Buddy-specific AR/camera interaction.

MIGRATE_NOW for WF-MIG-002 authorizes only fresh destination initialization and incremental reviewed Buddy-domain ports; it does not authorize source deletion or server-authority transfer before acceptance.
The one-screen mobile UX does not transfer general mobile/server authority to WellFit-Buddy or reward/mission authority to the client.
